name: trackyourtime

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/invoice-pdf run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/invoice-pdf run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server run build
scripts.build:client: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/invoice-pdf run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.build:raycast: pnpm --filter trackyourtime-raycast run vendor && pnpm --filter trackyourtime-raycast run build
scripts.build:mcp: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter trackyourtime-mcp run build
scripts.test:mcp:integration: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter trackyourtime-mcp run test:integration
scripts.dev:raycast: pnpm --filter trackyourtime-raycast run vendor && pnpm --filter trackyourtime-raycast run dev
scripts.build:extension: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/extension run build
scripts.build:extension:prod: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/extension run build:prod
scripts.build:extension:firefox: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/extension run build:firefox
scripts.openapi:emit: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server exec tsx src/api/v1/emit-openapi.ts
scripts.contract:emit: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server exec tsx src/contract/emit-trpc-contract.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @starter/core run test && pnpm --filter trackyourtime-raycast run test && pnpm --filter @starter/server run test && pnpm --filter trackyourtime-mcp run test && pnpm --filter @starter/extension run test && pnpm run test:desktop
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/invoice-pdf run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm -r --filter '!@starter/shared' --filter '!@starter/invoice-pdf' --filter '!@starter/core' run typecheck && pnpm typecheck:desktop
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @starter/client run lint && pnpm --filter trackyourtime-raycast run lint
scripts.prod:win: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.trackyourtime.dev node scripts/build-desktop.mjs --package --dir --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc && node scripts/crossplat/vm-drop.mjs --project trackyourtime --platform windows-arm64 --source release/win-arm64-unpacked --launch "Track Your Time.exe" --note api.trackyourtime.dev
scripts.cap:run:ios: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs ios && cap run ios --no-sync
scripts.cap:run:android: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cap run android --no-sync
scripts.build:ios:release: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android:release: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease

description: Free, open-source time tracker for freelancers that turns billable hours into reports and invoices, hosted or self-hosted.
author: Rico Trebeljahr
